sources.title: RK1820/RK1828 — Firefly Wiki
sources.snippet: RK1820/RK1828 ¶ RK3588 Soc (Host) : As the core of the system, responsible for task scheduling, resource allocation, and overall control. RK1820/RK1828 Coprocessor (Device) : As an AI computing acceleration unit, we focus on high-performance neural network inference tasks. PCIe : Realize low latency and high bandwidth data exchange between the main control and co processors.
